item.title: EC meets today over polls schedule, referendum
item.description: The Election Commission (EC) sits today for a crucial full-commission meeting to review preparations for the 13th National Parlia-mentary Election and the upcoming national referendum-covering everything from pre-poll groundwork to post-poll management. item.title: 10 including pregnant woman burnt
item.description: Ten people, including a pregnant woman and children, suffered burn injuries in separate gas line explosions at residences in Dhaka's Agargaon and Narayanganj on Saturday morning.The injured were brought to the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery, confirmed Inspector Md Faruk, in-charge of the Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) police camp.The injured from Agargaon are: Md Jalil Mia, 50; Aneeza Begum, 40; Asif Mia, 19; Sakib Mia, 16; Monira, 17; and Eva, 6. item.title: Tourists among 23 killed in nightclub fire in India's Goa state
item.description: At least 23 people died after a fire at a nightclub in India's Goa state, the chief minister of the state said on Sunday as videos on social media showed ambulances lining up to help the injured.The incident occurred around 12:04 am local time (1834 GMT Saturday) in the village of Arpora, the state's police chief told reporters.The state government has ordered an inquiry into this incident, chief minister Pramod Sawant said in a post on X.Fire trucks and ambulances were rushed to the spot after

item.title: 7.0 quake shakes remote area straddling Alaska, Canada
item.description: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake on Saturday shook a mountainous, sparsely populated area straddling the border of the US state of Alaska and Canada's Yukon territory, seismologists said.The temblor at 2041 GMT was followed by more than 30 aftershocks ranging from magnitude 5.1 to 3.3 over the next three hours, according to the US Geological Survey.The epicenter was about 155 miles (248 kilometers) west of Whitehorse, the capital of Canada's Yukon, and 230 miles northwest of Alaska's capital

item.title: Messi bids 'special' farewell to Alba, Busquets with MLS Cup
item.description: Inter Miami captain Lionel Messi paid tribute to Jordi Alba and Sergio Busquets after helping his longtime teammates retire with one final trophy in Saturday's MLS Cup final.Miami beat the Vancouver Whitecaps 3-1 at Chase Stadium to deliver Miami's first MLS Cup title since joining the league in 2020 as an expansion team.The title was a 44th major honor of Messi's senior career, with many won alongside Alba and Busquets at Barcelona.Once Alba and Busquets announced their impending retirement fro

item.title: Arsenal falls, Man City close gap as Premier League title race tightens
item.description: A dramatic stoppage-time strike from substitute Emiliano Buendia handed Aston Villa a 2-1 victory over Arsenal on Saturday, blowing the Premier League title race wide open.Buendia slammed in a loose ball with the final kick of the match, ending Arsenal's unbeaten run since August 31 and cutting the league leader's advantage at the top.Arsenal had edged the first half, but Matty Cash put Villa ahead in the 36th minute. item.title: Exhumation begins to identify 114 July martyrs
item.description: A team of Criminal Investigation Department (CID)on Sunday morningstarted exhuming the bodies of 114 unknown martyrs of the July uprising, marking a decisive step toward restoring their names and stories.The exhumation work began in presence of Additional Inspector General of Police and Chief of the CID Md Shibgat Ullah at the cemetery beside Rayer Bazar Martyred Intellectuals Memorial in the capital.CID officials earlier visited the graves on December 2 at the Rayerbazar Intellectuals' Cemetery

item.title: Elderly freedom fighter couple found slaughtered in Rangpur
item.description: A freedom fighter and his wife have been found slaughtered in their house in Rangpur's Taraganj.Deceased Jogesh Chandra Roy, 75, a freedom fighter and a retired school teacher, and his wife Suborna Roy, 60, residents of Uttar Rahimapur area under Kursha union.Local people said the couple had two sons-- elder one is in Jaypurhat and younger one is working in Dhaka.
